To add a new person to Harbour CRM:

1. Go to **Contacts**.
2. Select **New contact**.
3. Enter a **First name** (required). All other fields are optional.
4. Optionally add **Last name**, **Email**, **Phone**, **Job title**, **Company** and **Status**.
5. Select **Save contact**.

The contact opens immediately so you can add notes or deals.
